_what_this_file_is: THREE STAGED QUEUE ENTRIES for the A3GC-R2 family, PREPARED AND NOT ENQUEUED. This file is NOT a queue entry itself and is NOT in verification/queue/. Each element of 'entries' is a complete entry that becomes queueable ONLY after the blocking_defects it carries are cleared by the dafoam-supervisor. prereg_commit and launch_cmd are deliberate non-existent placeholders in every one of them: FAIL CLOSED, so no element can launch anything if copied into the queue by accident.
_launch_order: DRAFT Sec.6.3: R2-L3 (~81 core-min) first -- it re-establishes the anchor under the corrected runScript and MEASURES Sec.5's GAMG scaling assumption at the cheapest level. Then R2-L2 (~326), then R2-L1 (~1,303) subject to the Sec.9 memory guard. A WAVE, never three at once.
_lane: dafoam lab-lane, 2026-09-12, on dafoam-supervisor's brief under Sanaa's directive item 5a. NOTHING LAUNCHED. SUBMISSIONS PARKED.

entries.cost_basis: DERIVED, NOT MEASURED, transcribed from A3GC_R2_PREREGISTRATION.md.DRAFT Sec.5's rate table. The rate is the ONLY measured r=1.1674 rate on this geometry: the 399,360-cell anchor ran 6000 iterations at np=4 with ExecutionTime 1221.21 s = 81.41 core-min, i.e. 3.398e-08 core-min per cell-outer-iteration. This level is the rate's own basis. TWO NAMED ASSUMPTIONS (Sec.5): (i) GAMG iteration count does not grow materially from 399,360 to 6,389,760 cells -- multigrid is designed for that, but it is an assumption and R2-L3 and R2-L2 measure it before R2-L1 launches; (ii) the real risk at the fine level is memory, not cost. Dollars DERIVED at the owner-stated $0.0513/core-h; this box cannot read its own billing (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER.md Sec.5).

entries._schema_note: Fields above are queue_entry_check.REQUIRED_FIELDS. Below is annotation the validator ignores, EXCEPT memory_footprint_gb, which Sanaa's item 7 requires and the validator does not know.
entries.memory_footprint_basis: 8.0 GiB CONTAINER CEILING, --memory-swap held EQUAL so container swap is DISABLED (Sanaa item 18). A BOUND, NOT A MEASUREMENT, and labelled so: the lab holds no RSS reading for DARhoSimpleCFoam on this family at any level. Generosity is free on a 123 GiB box with 120 GiB available, and the first R2 level to run replaces the bound with a measurement in the calibration row.
entries.memory_floor_gb_basis: 16.0 GiB MemAvailable required to START = ceiling + 8 GiB host headroom. A REFUSAL TO START, NEVER A CAP: it does not signal, throttle or shorten anything running. Below it the level is BLOCKED, not squeezed -- the DRAFT Sec.5's own word. At staging the box reads 120 GiB available of 123.

registered_level.why: DRAFT Sec.1.1. N, s0 and marchDist are byte-identical across all three levels, so ONE growth ratio and ONE first-cell height across the family and y+ is preserved. That is the entire repair: A3GC varied N alone while s0 and marchDist were pinned, forcing r = 2.0880 (L3) / 1.4006 (L2) / 1.1674 (anchor) -- levels that are not geometrically similar.

mesh_state.exists: YES, in THREE places, each probed read-only 2026-09-12 with a3gc_grade.py probe and each returning EXACTLY cells 399360 / wing nFaces 6240: /home/ubuntu/certonomous-runs/A3GC-AR1, /A3GC-AR1C, /A3-onera-m6-transonic.
mesh_state.caveat: DRAFT Sec.6.2 rules R2-L3 is a FRESH RUN regardless -- the anchor's CD carries the undriven-patchV defect (Sec.4.1) and may not be quoted; only its RESIDUAL evidence is admissible, and as evidence about the CAUSE, never as a level. Whether the MESH may be reused is the open ruling above.

checkpoint_policy.satisfies_sanaa_item_1: YES. 500 iterations at the Sec.5 rate is ~13 min of wall at the FINE level and less at the coarser ones, so no checkpoint interval anywhere in the family exceeds her 30 minutes. purgeWrite 2 keeps the last two and purges older, which is her clause verbatim, and endTime survives because it IS the last. 500 divides 6000 (12 writes), required by the runner's own G-COMPLETE clause 4.
checkpoint_policy.departure_registered_before_compute: a3gc_run.sh:91 currently carries WRITE_INTERVAL=2000, which at the fine level is ~54 min of wall and WOULD VIOLATE her 30-minute rule; and :326 carries purgeWrite 0 with the comment 'never purge: endTime must survive to be graded'. purgeWrite 2 keeps endTime, so the grader's requirement and her hygiene clause are compatible and the comment is over-broad. BOTH CHANGES ARE REGISTERED HERE BEFORE ANY R2 COMPUTE and must be READ BACK off each level's controlDict at launch, never assumed.
checkpoint_policy.uniform_across_the_family: 500 on ALL THREE levels, including the ones fast enough not to need it. A family whose levels differ in controlDict is one more uncontrolled variable, which is the exact class of defect R2 exists to repair.

sanaa_launch_preconditions.item_6_ubuntu_never_root: REGISTERED as -u 1000:1000 --group-add 1002 -e MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp. MEASURED on this box 2026-09-12: `-u 1000:1000` ALONE dies 'Permission denied' sourcing loadDAFoam.sh (the image's dafoamuser is uid 1002 and /home/dafoamuser is drwxr-x---, mode 750 on BOTH dafoam images checked); with `--group-add 1002` the same uid reaches LOADED_OK and id reads uid=1000(ubuntu) gid=1000(ubuntu) groups=1000(ubuntu),1002(dafoamuser). uid 1000 AND gid 1000 are both ubuntu, so artifacts land ubuntu:ubuntu. sanaa_launch_preconditions.item_10_registration_frozen: NOT YET -- .DRAFT, two of three Sec.8 questions open.

entries.mandatory_residual_reader: G-RESREAD, DRAFT Sec.10 (appended 2026-09-12). Any arm of this family that runs with non-orthogonal correctors ON must read residuals FIRST-MATCH-PER-EQUATION-PER-BLOCK. a3gc_grade.py:700-701 overwrites in a loop and returns the LAST match; with correctors on that is the last corrector's residual off an almost-solved field, and it was demonstrated 2026-09-12 to read back a planted 1.234e-09 as though it passed. REUSE a3gc_grade_l2r.py, md5 b188e7e1b0034a53267dc9b818138b8c, freeze 5eaa652fa, clause at :699-729, with its three-direction control -- DO NOT REWRITE IT. R2 registers nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0, where FIRST == LAST and the clause costs nothing today; it is registered anyway because DRAFT Sec.7 registers that corrector count as an explicit LEVER any failing level may pull, and a guard installed after the lever is pulled is a guard installed after the accident.
entries.cap_and_directive_17: NO cap_core_min_registered. Sanaa's item 10 asks for a 3x cap; her directive #17 (2026-09-12) says no run is stopped by a cap. queue_runner.cap_watch will write ESTIMATE_OVERRUN.txt at 1.10 x the estimate; that flag REPORTS and never terminates, which is the only behaviour compatible with #17. Per the chief's reading #1, a genuine conflict goes supervisor -> chief -> Sanaa and nothing is killed on a cap meanwhile. Note the DRAFT Sec.5 still carries the line 'An overrun stops the run'; that predates #17 and is FLAGGED FOR THE SUPERVISOR, not edited by this lane.
blocking_defects: BLOCKER 1 -- THE PRE-REGISTRATION IS NOT FROZEN. A3GC_R2_PREREGISTRATION.md.DRAFT, and Sec.8 questions 1 (is a3gc_grade_R2_GFIELD.diff applied, or does Sec.4.4 revert to A3GC Sec.3.6) and 3 (does R2 supersede A3GC) are reserved to the supervisor. Question 2 (the Sec.5 memory guard) is CLOSED by the 2026-09-12 revision, Sec.9. prereg_commit is a deliberate non-sha placeholder: FAIL CLOSED.

BLOCKER 2 -- THERE IS NO LAUNCH INSTRUMENT. a3gc_run.sh is itself a DRAFT and its --level accepts only L3|L2|L1|AR1; no R2 level id exists in it, and its RANKS/WANT_CELLS/WANT_WING tables have no R2 rows. launch_cmd above names a deliberately non-existent path so this entry cannot launch anything if copied.

BLOCKER 3 -- R2-L2's MESH EXISTS NOWHERE and a3gc_genmesh.sh has no table entry for c1 x 64 layers (its tables are L3/L2/L1/AR1; none is 1,597,440 cells). That instrument change is the supervisor's, and it lands on a file whose A3GC AMENDMENT 5 md5 pin is ALREADY STALE -- pin 9fa240d9643308f5e9a4988614b58884, disk and HEAD 2a1f45c06aa8912f5eb84d929fa54df1 since commit 8b16844fa (2026-09-12T05:27:25Z). a3gc_L1_wrapper.sh re-verifies that pin and exits 90 today. Must be repaired in the same act.
BLOCKER 4 -- Sanaa item 5's kill-and-resume proof for the steady-OpenFOAM class is owed and not run.

If the ruling is no, R2-L3 and R2-L1 regenerate and Sec.5's cost table gains stage-1 time it does not carry.
